# CIO Survey 2026 AI Adoption, Governance, and Cybersecurity

> 来源：https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jenny-tan-phd-064b3122_2026-state-of-the-cio-survey-findings-insights-activity-7490202349479579648-wgq4（2026-10-25 抓取；C 级：域名 linkedin.com 是播客/聚合站/自媒体平台，不能当官方或权威来源（C）；参考：authority=3、站点「LinkedIn · Fabian Warislohner」（仅供参考，不影响定级））

## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

The biggest constraint may not be technology, but access to the right talent and skills - top barrier to implementing AI initiatives is the lack of in-house AI expertise (40%), ahead of unclear ROI metrics (32%) and unclear AI strategy (31%).

Governance, clear ROI metrics, and accountability are becoming critical success factors for AI adoption - only 19% of respondents say their AI initiatives have met or exceeded ROI expectations, reinforcing the principle that sustainable AI success requires governance, accountability, and clear measurement frameworks, not just technology deployment.

Cybersecurity remains foundational, especially as organizations scale AI across the enterprise - as organizations scale AI, increasing cybersecurity protection ranks among the top business priorities (32%).

55% of organizations are increasing investments in security and risk management.
